summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend test of weekly reminders & late-fee engine. 39/39 pytest tests passing (23 regression + 16 new for settings/reminders/late fee). Admin Settings UI verified end-to-end (login -> dashboard quick action -> all testIDs render & persist via PUT /admin/settings). Customer payments UI verified with backdated payment (4 days overdue, fee=50/day, grace=0): shows total ₹900, fee-break-<id> line '₹700 rent + ₹200 late fee', and red 'Overdue' status chip. All acceptance criteria met.

ui_bugs.issue: Home screen shows base amount only (₹700) with status 'Pending', not the total inclusive of late_fee (₹900) and not 'Overdue'. Payments screen is correct, but the home card is inconsistent with the payments screen for overdue users. Consider showing amount + late_fee total here too.

action_items: (Optional, LOW) Update customer/home.tsx Weekly Payment hero card to use (amount + late_fee) and switch label to 'Overdue' when late_fee > 0, matching the payments list behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: Late fee engine uses date().days difference (calendar-day based) so a payment 23h overdue would compute 0 days; that is acceptable per spec but worth documenting.
scheduler_loop fires within the *hour* window (now_ist.hour == target_hr) and uses last_fired_date guard so it's idempotent for the day — correct.
PUT /admin/settings re-runs _compute_late_fees_once() when fee/grace changes — good for instant UI update.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin settings + customer overdue chip flows verified)

seed_data_creation: Created test vehicle 'OverdueBike' and assigned to customer phone 9876512345 with a pending payment backdated 4 days. This lives in MongoDB; safe to leave (prefixed TEST-OD).
